description: This file contains a set of unit tests for Orleans serialization components, specifically focusing on converter-based serialization mechanisms involving foreign library types. It defines multiple test classes to verify encoding, copying, and handling of various foreign and wrapper types, including derived and value types.

classes.name: ConverterCodecTests
classes.description: Tests for converting foreign library types using Orleans serialization with codec-based mechanisms.

classes.name: ConverterCopierTests
classes.description: Tests for copying foreign library types in Orleans serialization.

classes.name: WrappedConverterCodecTests
classes.description: Tests for converting wrapped foreign library types.

classes.name: WrappedConverterCopierTests
classes.description: Tests for copying wrapped foreign library types.

classes.name: StructConverterCodecTests
classes.description: Tests for converting value types (structs) from foreign libraries using Orleans serialization.

classes.name: StructConverterCopierTests
classes.description: Tests for copying value types (structs) from foreign libraries.

classes.name: WrappedStructConverterCodecTests
classes.description: Tests for converting wrapped value types.

classes.name: WrappedStructConverterCopierTests
classes.description: Tests for copying wrapped value types.

classes.name: DerivedConverterCodecTests
classes.description: Tests for converting derived types from foreign libraries.

classes.name: CombinedConverterCopierTests
classes.description: Tests for copying types with multiple serialization mechanisms.
